q: My factory has two electricity connections. Do I just add both bills?
title: Two electricity meters, one factory
short: Yes, add every connection that serves the site, but first check none is a check meter on the same supply. Two separate consumer numbers are two supplies and both count. A sub-meter or check meter behind the main meter would count the same units twice.
audience: MSMEs with more than one power connection

ul: Different consumer numbers on different bills: separate supplies, add them.
A meter you read yourself behind the main meter: a sub-meter, do not add it.
A DISCOM check meter: same supply, use the billing meter.

p: List each connection once with its consumer number, so the same bill is never counted twice in a later month.

example.title: Adding them
lines: HT connection: 42,000 kWh; LT connection: 3,500 kWh
